key.name: always-use-location-entry
key.summary: Always use the location entry, instead of the pathbar
key.description: If set to true, Files will always use a textual input entry for the location toolbar, instead of the pathbar.

key.name: recursive-search
key.description: Locations in which Files should search subfolders. Available values are “local-only”, “always”, “never”.

key.name: search-filter-time-type
key.summary: Filter the search dates using either last used or last modified
key.description: Filter the search dates using either last used or last modified.

key.name: show-delete-permanently
key.summary: Whether to show a context menu item to delete permanently
key.description: If set to true, Files will show a delete permanently context menu item to bypass the Trash.

key.name: show-create-link
key.summary: Whether to show context menu items to create links from copied or selected files
key.description: If set to true, Files will show context menu items to create links from the copied or selected files.

key.name: show-directory-item-counts
key.summary: When to show number of items in a folder
key.description: Speed tradeoff for when to show the number of items in a folder. If set to “always” then always show item counts, even if the folder is on a remote server. If set to “local-only” then only show counts for local file systems. If set to “never” then never bother to compute item counts.

key.name: click-policy
key.summary: Type of click used to launch/open files
key.description: Possible values are “single” to launch files on a single click, or “double” to launch them on a double click.

key.name: mouse-use-extra-buttons
key.summary: Use extra mouse button events in Files
key.description: For users with mice that have “Forward” and “Back” buttons, this key will determine if any action is taken inside of Files when either is pressed.

key.name: mouse-forward-button
key.summary: Mouse button to activate the “Forward” command in browser window
key.description: For users with mice that have buttons for “Forward” and “Back”, this key will set which button activates the “Forward” command in a browser window. Possible values range between 6 and 14.

key.name: mouse-back-button
key.summary: Mouse button to activate the “Back” command in browser window
key.description: For users with mice that have buttons for “Forward” and “Back”, this key will set which button activates the “Back” command in a browser window. Possible values range between 6 and 14.

key.name: show-image-thumbnails
key.summary: When to show thumbnails of files
key.description: Speed trade-off for when to show a file as a thumbnail. If set to “always” then always thumbnail, even if the folder is on a remote server. If set to “local-only” then only show thumbnails for local file systems. If set to “never” then never bother to thumbnail files, just use a generic icon. Despite what the name may suggest, this applies to any previewable file type.

key.name: thumbnail-limit
key.description: Images over this size (in megabytes) won’t be thumbnailed. The purpose of this setting is to avoid thumbnailing large images that may take a long time to load or use lots of memory.

key.name: default-sort-order
key.description: The default sort-order for items in the icon view. Possible values are “name”, “size”, “type”, “mtime”, “atime” and “starred”.

key.name: default-sort-in-reverse-order
key.summary: Reverse sort order in new windows
key.description: If true, files in new windows will be sorted in reverse order. I.e., if sorted by name, then instead of sorting the files from “a” to “z”, they will be sorted from “z” to “a”; if sorted by size, instead of being incrementally they will be sorted decrementally.

key.name: default-folder-viewer
key.description: When a folder is visited this viewer is used. Possible values are “list-view”, and “icon-view”.

key.name: show-hidden-files
key.description: This key is deprecated and ignored. The “show-hidden” key from “org.gtk.Settings.FileChooser” is now used instead.

key.name: migrated-gtk-settings
key.description: Whether settings shared with GtkFileChooser have been migrated from their GTK 3 keys to the GTK 4 ones.

key.name: open-folder-on-dnd-hover
key.summary: Whether to open the hovered folder after a timeout when drag and drop operation
key.description: If this is set to true, when performing a drag and drop operation the hovered folder will open automatically after a timeout.

key.name: fts-enabled
key.summary: Whether to have full text search enabled by default when opening a new window/tab
key.description: If set to true, Files will also match the file contents besides the name. This toggles the default active state, which can still be overridden in the search popover

key.name: date-time-format
key.summary: How to display file timestamps in the views
key.description: If set to 'simple', Files will show Today and Yesterday with time, otherwise the exact date without time. If set to 'detailed', it will always show the exact date and time.

key.name: default-compression-format
key.description: The format that will be selected when compressing files.

key.name: captions
key.summary: List of possible captions on icons
key.description: A list of captions below an icon in the icon view. The actual number of captions shown depends on the zoom level. Some possible values are: “size”, “type”, “date_modified”, “owner”, “group”, “permissions”, and “mime_type”.

key.name: use-tree-view
key.description: Whether a tree should be used for list view navigation instead of a flat list.

key.name: initial-size
key.description: A tuple containing the initial width and height of the app window.

key.name: maximized
key.summary: Whether the navigation window should be maximized
key.description: Whether the navigation window should be maximized by default.

key.name: initial-size-file-chooser
key.summary: Initial size of the file chooser window
key.description: A tuple containing the initial width and height of the file chooser window.

key.name: visible
key.description: Whether the terminal pane should be visible by default in new windows.

key.name: pane-size
key.description: Height of the terminal panel in pixels.

key.name: font
key.description: The font to use for the terminal. If empty, the system monospace font from org.gnome.desktop.interface is used.

key.name: font-size
key.description: The font size to use for the embedded terminal in point units.

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: The color scheme to use for the embedded terminal. Available values: 'system', 'dark', 'light', 'solarized-dark', 'solarized-light', 'matrix', 'one-half-dark', 'one-half-light', 'monokai'.

key.name: local-sync-mode
key.description: Determines how the embedded terminal synchronizes its current directory with the file manager when navigating local folders. 'none': No synchronization. 'fm-to-term': File manager navigation changes terminal directory. 'term-to-fm': Terminal navigation changes file manager location. 'both': Synchronization works in both directions.

key.name: ssh-auto-connect-mode
key.summary: SSH terminal auto-connection and synchronization mode preference
key.description: Determines behavior when an SFTP location is active. 'off': Do not connect automatically. 'sync-both': Connect and sync both ways. 'sync-fm-to-term': Connect and sync File Manager to Terminal. 'sync-term-to-fm': Connect and sync Terminal to File Manager. 'sync-none': Connect without folder synchronization.
